_comment: Octail's own egg (plan §6.4), written from the game's official dedicated server guide (returntomoria.com/news-updates/dedicated-server); games-steamcmd's lotr_moria egg (AGPLv3) was only read for reference, nothing is copied from it. The install writes a first MoriaServerConfig.ini with the keys the guide documents (an existing one is kept) and the Startup tab's password, world name, world type, seed, difficulty and port are set in it (ini parser) before every start; the log (Moria/Saved/Logs/Moria.log) is followed on the console, the start is detected from the bound game port (x_octail.features.ready) or the invite code line, Ctrl+C (which the server answers by saving and quitting) is handed to it by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1) and waited for, vcrun2022 is installed into the Wine prefix once (WINETRICKS_RUN), and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Reclaim the Dwarven realm of Moria: mine, craft and build in procedurally generated worlds with up to eight players. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: wine ./Moria/Binaries/Win64/MoriaServer-Win64-Shipping.exe & MORIA_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${MORIA_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${MORIA_PID}" INT TERM; tail -c0 -F /home/container/Moria/Saved/Logs/Moria.log --pid=${MORIA_PID} 2>/dev/null & wait ${MORIA_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Moria/Binaries/Win64/MoriaServer-Win64-Shipping.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Return to Moria dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the server reads MoriaServerConfig.ini next to MoriaServer.exe (without one, its first start only writes
## one). A first one is written here with the keys the official guide documents; an existing one is kept. The
## Startup tab's values are set in it (ini parser) before every start.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Moria/Saved/Logs
CFG=/mnt/server/MoriaServerConfig.ini
if [[ ! -f "$CFG" ]]; then
    cat > "$CFG" <<'EOF'
; Return to Moria dedicated server settings, written by the Octail install.
; The Startup tab sets the password, world name, world type, seed, difficulty and port before every start.
; Edit the rest only while the server is stopped.

[Main]
; Players must enter it to join. Empty = no password.
OptionalPassword=

[World]
; The world to load; a world with this name is created from [World.Create] when there is none.
Name=Octail World

[World.Create]
; Only used when a new world is created: campaign or sandbox.
Type=campaign
; random, or a number.
Seed=random
; story, solo, normal, hard or custom.
Difficulty.Preset=normal
; With Difficulty.Preset=custom: verylow, low, default, high or veryhigh.
Difficulty.Custom.CombatDifficulty=default
Difficulty.Custom.EnemyAggression=default
Difficulty.Custom.SurvivalDifficulty=default
Difficulty.Custom.MiningDrops=default
Difficulty.Custom.WorldDrops=default
Difficulty.Custom.HordeFrequency=default
Difficulty.Custom.SiegeFrequency=default
Difficulty.Custom.PatrolFrequency=default

[Host]
; Empty binds every address.
ListenAddress=
ListenPort=7777
; auto detects the public address players connect to.
AdvertiseAddress=auto
; -1 = the ListenPort.
AdvertisePort=-1
InitialConnectionRetryTime=60
AfterDisconnectionRetryTime=600

[Console]
Enabled=true

[Performance]
; 60 is plenty; 30 if the server uses too much CPU.
ServerFPS=60
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: The world to load (Moria/Saved/SaveGamesDedicated). A new name creates a new world from the settings below; the old one stays.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join (case-sensitive). Empty = no password.

variables.name: World Type
variables.description: For a new world: campaign or sandbox.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: For a new world: story, solo, normal, hard, or custom (the Difficulty.Custom values in MoriaServerConfig.ini).

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: For a new world: random, or a number.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).

variables.name: Winetricks
variables.description: Installed into the Wine prefix once, at the first start (the server needs the Visual C++ runtime).
